description: This PHP script manages updating and deleting related module records within the vtiger CRM system. It processes request parameters, interacts with CRM entities, and redirects to the appropriate view after performing database operations.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Represents a CRM entity with methods to retrieve instances and perform operations such as delete and save related modules.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method that returns an instance of CRMEntity for the current module.

methods.name: delete_related_module
methods.description: Deletes related records for a module relationship.

methods.name: save_related_module
methods.description: Saves or adds new related records to a module relationship.
